initial_assertion.statement: Milne C.6 and the following paragraph provide the smooth separated finite-type Neron model, etale base change, identity subgroup and finite geometric component group under the stated one-dimensional normal-base hypotheses.
initial_assertion.objects: Fixed local elliptic curve B/F, its Neron model and identity subgroup; finite unramified Fprime/F.
initial_assertion.hypotheses: F is a nonarchimedean characteristic-zero local field; its complete DVR has finite perfect residue field; B and any finite list of curves are fixed.
initial_assertion.quantifiers: Every finite unramified extension of the fixed local field; the common multiple only for a fixed finite list.
initial_assertion.parameter_range: Neron geometry and component quotient over complete discrete valuation rings, including even-degree unramified extensions.
initial_assertion.uniformity: Geometric component order fixed under etale base change; no uniformity over arbitrary curves.
initial_assertion.constants: c_B is the order of the finite geometric component group; use a common multiple only for the fixed finite list.
initial_assertion.normalizations: B0(Fprime) means points of the identity open subgroup; distinguish geometric component group from rational component count.
initial_assertion.exceptional_cases: No good-reduction or semistability hypothesis asserted; no ramified base-change or H1 conclusion supplied.
initial_assertion.limit_order: Fix curve and local field, apply published Neron geometry, specialize under etale extension, then use component quotient; cohomology and limits remain later separate inputs.
